Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have for you from this coverage. The sixth T20I of the UAE Summer T20I Bash between United Arab Emirates and Ireland will be played on Sunday, 10th October at 9.00 am local (5.00 am GMT). Do join us for that. Till then, goodbye and take care!
Karthik Meiyappan is named as the MAN OF THE MATCH for his brilliant bowling display.
OUT! TAKEN! Length ball, outside off. Craig Young chips it straight towards covers. Alishan Sharafu is present over there and grabs the catch with ease. United Arab Emirates win by 54 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Alishan Sharafu b Waseem Muhammad

Commentary.Commentary: Earlier in the day, Ireland put UAE into bat which did not prove to be a fruitful decision as the hosts put up a big total of 163 runs on the board. It was always going to be tough for the Irish batters today but no one expected them to bat this poorly. In the end, the UAE bowlers were excellent and Ireland suffered a heavy defeat.

United Arab Emirates did put up a stellar performance with the bat earlier in the day but their bowling performance was even better. UAE are known for their bowling and today they just proved how good their bowlers can be when on song. Akif Raja was the star upfront with the ball as he got a wicket each in his first 3 overs, setting the Irish batsmen on the back foot inside the Powerplay. They kept it tight in the middle overs and then Karthik Meiyappan just came in and spun a web around the Irish batters as he ended up scalping 4 wickets. In the end it was a very comfortable victory for the hosts.

Ireland got off to a woeful start as they lost their power hitter, Paul Stirling in the second over. The misery didn't stop there as they lost another 2 wickets inside the Powerplay and never really recovered from that position. Curtis Campher and Gareth Delany did put up a fightback but that didn't last for too long either. Wickets kept tumbling in every couple of overs and the asking rate was just out of reach. Ireland will be thoroughly disappointed by that sorry display with the bat today.
United Arab Emirates have come roaring back and have avenged yesterday's defeat by putting up a stellar performance. Ireland on the other will be disappointed with their overall performance today.
Fuller in length, on off. Young drills it towards extra cover. The fielder there misfields and allows the batters to come back for the second.
Outside off, left alone.
Short of a length, outside off. Young makes room for himself and carves it behind point for a couple of runs.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower and shorter on middle, Young is deceived by the pace and gets beaten.
Full and outside off, Young swings but misses.
A low full toss on middle, worked to point for a single.
Full and on leg, Young looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls to point. The batters take a leg bye.
Short of a length, outside off. Young tries to heave it over long on but fails to get any bat on it.
Length ball, on middle. Young looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards covers and the batters take a single. Akif Raja appeals for an LBW but the umpire says no.
On a length, outside off. Young keeps it out.

In the air, but safe! Short ball, on middle. Josh Little goes for the pull shot but doesn't time it that well. The ball is skied up towards the mid-wicket region. Chirag Suri runs from mid on to take the catch but the ball falls well short of him. A single is taken.
Good-length ball on middle and leg. Little looks to work it on the leg side but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Short of a length, on off. Little looks to upper cut but fails to connect.
WIDE! Length ball, way too outside off. Little swings but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Good-length ball, outside off. Josh Little flashes his bat hard but to no avail.
Tosses it up, outside off. Little tries to reverse sweep but misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball and the batters take a bye.
Josh Little is the last man in for Ireland.
Who comes in?

OUT! CAUGHT! Karthik Meiyappan strikes again! He bowls a loopy ball, on middle. Mark Adair advances down the track and smacks it towards deep cover. Gets the height but not the elevation. Basil Hameed tracks back and takes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Basil Hameed b Karthik Meiyappan

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! What a shot! Loopy ball, outside off. Mark Adair steps out and smacks it through covers for a boundary..
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT! A googly from Karthik Meiyappan, on off. Neil Rock dances down the track and looks to heave it on the leg side. The ball goes off the top edge towards point. Akif Raja settles under the ball and pouches it with ease. He can do nothing wrong and another one bites the dust for Ireland. Craig Young walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Akif Raja b Karthik Meiyappan

Commentary.Commentary: In the air, but safe! Slower through the air, outside off. Mark Adair lifts it towards deep cover for a single.
Length ball, on leg. Neil Rock charges down the track and looks to heave it on the leg side but is cut in half. An excellent over from Zahoor Khan. A wicket and 3 runs from it.
A pacy ball, on off. Adair punches it towards covers for one.
Fuller in length, outside off. Mark Adair looks to slice it over covers but misses.
On a length, outside off. Adair plays it back to the bowler.
Full again, outside off. Mark Adair looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes towards fine leg and the batters take a couple of runs.
Mark Adair comes in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Zahoor Khan strikes with the first ball in his comeback spell. Bowls it fuller and outside off. Simi Singh looks to heave it away but miscues. The ball goes off the outside edge and Vriitya Aravind takes the simplest of catches behind the stumps. United Arab Emirates in commanding position. Ireland need 74 more from 35 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Vriitya Aravind b Zahoor Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Zahoor Khan comes back on.
On the pads and Rock works it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple. 9 runs and a wicket off that over. IRE need 74 runs in 36 balls.
Nicely flighted, on the stumps. Simi Singh nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Simi Singh is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Karthik Meiyappan has done the trick again for his team as he sends a set George Dockrell back to the pavilion. Tossed up, wide outside off. Dokcrell reaches for his and looks to go over covers but just doesn't get enough elevation. The ball goes straight to Muhammad Usman, who takes a sharp catch at cover-point.
Commentary.Howout: c Muhammad Usman b Karthik Meiyappan

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on off and pushed back to the bowler.
Around off and pushed towards the cover region.
SIX! Bang! Flatter one, around off. George Dockrell charges down the track and smokes it way over the long on fence for a biggie. New ball, please!
Nice flight, around off. This is pushed down the ground for a single.
TWO LEG BYES! Again its full and on the pads, Dockrell misses the flick this time. The ball goes off the pads and towards fine leg. They get a couple of leg byes.
Full and on the pads, Dockrell flicks it fine on the leg side for a couple.
Quicker one, pushed towards covers.
Dropped! Tossed up again, Neil Rock looks for the big hit but ends up mistiming it. The ball is skied towards long off, where the catch is fumbled. They get a single.
Basil Hameed to roll his arms.
Flighted delivery, on off and pushed to mid off.
Tossed up, full and straight. Dockrell defends it out.
Flatter one, around off, this is cut away to third man for a single.
Neil Rock walks out to bat.

OUT! Cleaned him up! Quick and very full on the stumps. Curtis Campher doesn't pick the wrong one and ends up playing all around it. The ball sneaks under the bat and crashes into the stumps. Karthik Meiyappan strikes and UAE right on top at the moment.
In the air...safe! Tossed up, around off. Dockrell chips it towards long off for another one.
On middle and leg, Campher works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fullish ball, around off stump. George Dockrell steps out and drills it to long off for a run.
On the pads and flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Fired in full and outside off. Campher nudges it behind point for a couple. The throw is a wild one and they get a run off the overthrow as well.
SIX! BANG! Dragged down this time and Curtis Campher muscles it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On middle and this is eased down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Campher works it to deep square leg for one.
Slower one, on the stumps. Dockrell crunches it to sweeper cover for one.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Wided.
Floats it up, on middle. Curtis Campher reverse-sweeps it to third man for a couple of runs. At the halfway mark, Ireland are 57/4. 107 needed from 60 balls.
Full and on off, drilled to long off for a single again.
On middle, worked to long off for a run.
Tosses it up, outside off. Curtis Campher rocks back and cuts it to deep cover. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it comfortably.
Flighted ball, on off. Campher knocks it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on off. George Dockrell looks to defend. The ball goes off the inside half towards square leg for a single.
Karthik Meiyappan is brought into the attack now.
Loopy ball on leg, Dockrell tucks it to mid-wicket for a single. 50 up for Ireland!
George Dockrell comes in at number 6.

OUT! STUMPED! Gareth Delany loses his concentration and has to depart now. Slower through the air, on leg. Gareth Delany shimmies down the track and looks to push it on the off side but misses it completely. Vriitya Aravind collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. Ireland lose their fourth wicket. United Arab Emirates right on top at the moment. 115 needed from 67 balls.
Commentary.Howout: st Vriitya Aravind b Ahmed Raza

Commentary.Commentary: Tosses it up, outside off. Delany guides it to third man for a brace.
On middle, worked to long on for a run.
Loopy ball, on leg. Delany works it to deep cover for one.
Ahmed Raza comes into the attack now.
Floats it up, on middle. Delany pushes it back to the bowler.
On a good length, on off. Delany plays it down the ground to long off for a single.
Length ball, outside off, the ball stays low a bit. Gareth Delany looks to push it on the off side but fails to get any bat on it.
Good-length ball, on off. Campher plays it towards covers for a single.

Length ball, outside off. Curtis Campher rocks back and cuts it past backward point. The batters scamper back for the second run. The fielder throws the ball to the keeper but he fails to collect it. Easy two in the end.
On off, pushed to mid off for a run.

Short of a length, outside off. Gareth Delany slaps it towards deep cover. The fielder from deep point runs to his right and dives to stop the ball. Saves a certain boundary for his side. Two runs taken.
Bowling change.
Good-length ball, on middle. Gareth Delany punches it through covers. He retains the strike by picking up a single.
Good-length ball, on off. Delany dabs it towards point.
On middle, Curtis Campher nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, on off. Delany pushes it through covers for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Delany looks to slash it away but misses.
On a length, on off. Delany defends it towards covers.

Good-length ball, on middle and leg, angling in. Gareth Delany looks to defend but gets an inside edge. Akif Raja appeals for an LBW but the umpire is not interested. The ball rolls towards covers and the batters take a run.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Good-length ball, on off, angling in. Curtis Campher looks to cut but misses.
Length ball, on off. Campher pushes it to cover.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a match Akif Raja is having. He bags his third wicket. Bowls a length ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien makes room for himself and reaches out for it. He only manages to get an outside edge. The ball carries through to the keeper, Vriitya Aravind who takes a good catch. Ireland in a spot of bother now. They lose their third wicket inside the Powerplay.
Commentary.Howout: c Vriitya Aravind b Akif Raja

Commentary.Commentary: Curtis Campher is the new man in.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side, Kevin O'Brien looks to tuck it but misses. Wided.
FOUR! Runs are coming thick and fast now. Short of a length, outside off. Kevin O'Brien slices it towards third man for a boundary.
A slower ball, outside off and this is nudged to point.
FOUR! Short and wide again. Delany thumps it off the back foot past point and the ball races away into the fence.
Full and wide, driven to extra cover by Delany.
A fullish ball, on middle and flicked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and wide, Gareth Delany slices it behind point and picks up a boundary.
Good-length ball, angling into off stump. Gareth Delany defends it on the off side.
Gareth Delany is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Akif Raja strikes yet again. Short again and Andy Balbirnie looks to pull but mistimes it badly. The ball is skied towards the square leg fence. Waseem Muhammad takes a good catch and the skipper has to depart. Ireland on the back foot here.
Commentary.Howout: c Waseem Muhammad b Akif Raja

Commentary.Commentary: Banged into the deck around off. Andy Balbirnie looks to steer it towards backward point but gets beaten by the extra bounce.
FOUR! Cut away! Short of a length, on off. Andy Balbirnie rocks back and cuts it past backward point for a boundary.
Short of a length, on middle. Kevin O'Brien pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Short of a good length, outside off. Kevin O'Brien goes over extra cover and finds the fence.
A quick bumper this time, Balbirnie mistimes his pull towards deep square leg and picks up a single.
Full and on off, squeezed to cover-point.
Slower short ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien completely gets deceived by the lack of pace.
Full and straight, driven towards the cover region for a quick single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Balbirnie steps out looking to go over covers but misses.
Fullish ball, defended off the front foot by Andy Balbirnie.
On the pads and this is flicked fine on the leg side for a couple.
Full, around off. Andy Balbirnie creams it towards covers for a single.
Andy Balbirnie is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Akif Raja has got the big wicket of Paul Stirling. Shortish ball, outside off. Paul Stirling looks to smoke it downtown but the ball goes off the toe end of the bat. The ball is skied and Muhammad Usman at mid on takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Muhammad Usman b Akif Raja

Commentary.Commentary: On leg stump, Stirling makes room to paddle but doesn't connect.
Back of a length, around off. Paul Stirling punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Short of a length, angled into the body. Kevin O'Brien looks to pull but misses. The ball goes off the inside edge onto the pads and the batters take a single.
Akif Raja to bowl from the other end.
A good-length ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien looks to cut but misses.
Slower one, on the pads and this is pushed to mid on for a run.
Dropped! Fullish ball, around off. Kevin O'Brien creams it towards cover and the fielder dives to his left but fumbles.
Length ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien looks to poke at it but misses.
TWO WIDES! Down the leg side and beats the keeper as well. They get a single and a wide is signalled.
Good-length ball, around off and this one bounces a bit extra. Stirling is taken by surprise.
Length again, on the pads and Kevin O'Brien is also off the mark with a single towards deep mid-wicket.
Back of a length on middle, Stirling works it to mid-wicket for a single. He is off the mark.
